November Newsletter

Hello everyone! We're excited to share what's coming up in ArcheAge Classic this month! Let's dive into the highlights:

1.3 Release Review

Patch 1.3 has been a fantastic success! We've seen an influx of new players and a surge of activity in the game. The new Emerald Weapons have been a popular addition, and the overall engagement has been incredible. Seeing the community come alive like this has been inspiring for the entire team, and it motivates us to keep pushing forward.

Development Cycle & Patch 1.3.2

We've been revisiting our development process, and we're committing to the schedule we outlined a few months ago: an "A Week" and "B Week" cycle. "A Weeks" will focus on smaller changes and bug fixes, while "B Weeks" will deliver more substantial updates with new content. This cycle will give us the flexibility to work on bigger features while ensuring consistent updates when needed.

Our next "B Week" is set for November 20th, bringing patch 1.3.2. While we don't want to spoil too much, you can look forward to additional New Player Housing options and the first batch of Dawnsdrop Tools!

Introducing: The Addon Manager

We're thrilled to introduce a new community-made utility: the Addon Manager! Thanks to Sami, managing your addons is now easier than ever, with simple one-click installs. We encourage anyone interested in addons to give it a try.

We plan to integrate the Addon Manager directly into our launcher, making it even easier for everyone to enhance their game experience. Read more about how to install addons on our wiki 👉 https://wiki.aa-classic.com/Addons

Ghost Wedding Festival - 20/11 ~~ 4/12

The Ghost Wedding Festival will make a return towards the end of November, on top of some gifts related to Thanksgiving!

Unused Names Recycling

During next week's maintenance, we'll be freeing up unused character names. Characters meeting the criteria below will be offered a free rename. You can reclaim your original name if no one else takes it, or choose a new one if needed.

Your name will be freed if:

  • Your character is level 54 or under and you have not played the game in 6+ months

That's all for this month's newsletter! We can't wait to see you in-game.

By the way... does anyone else see something strange in the sky?

== November Newsletter ==
Hello everyone! We're excited to share what's coming up in ArcheAge Classic this month! Let's dive into the highlights:

== 1.3 Release Review ==
Patch 1.3 has been a fantastic success! We've seen an influx of new players and a surge of activity in the game. The new Emerald Weapons have been a popular addition, and the overall engagement has been incredible. Seeing the community come alive like this has been inspiring for the entire team, and it motivates us to keep pushing forward.

== Development Cycle & Patch 1.3.2 ==
We've been revisiting our development process, and we're committing to the schedule we outlined a few months ago: an "A Week" and "B Week" cycle. "A Weeks" will focus on smaller changes and bug fixes, while "B Weeks" will deliver more substantial updates with new content. This cycle will give us the flexibility to work on bigger features while ensuring consistent updates when needed.

Our next "B Week" is set for November 20th, bringing patch 1.3.2. While we don't want to spoil too much, you can look forward to additional New Player Housing options and the first batch of Dawnsdrop Tools!

== Introducing: The Addon Manager ==
We're thrilled to introduce a new community-made utility: the Addon Manager! Thanks to Sami, managing your addons is now easier than ever, with simple one-click installs. We encourage anyone interested in addons to give it a try.

We plan to integrate the Addon Manager directly into our launcher, making it even easier for everyone to enhance their game experience.
Read more about how to install addons on our wiki 👉 https://wiki.aa-classic.com/Addons

== Ghost Wedding Festival - 20/11 ~~ 4/12 ==
The Ghost Wedding Festival will make a return towards the end of November, on top of some gifts related to Thanksgiving!

== Unused Names Recycling ==
During next week's maintenance, we'll be freeing up unused character names. Characters meeting the criteria below will be offered a free rename. You can reclaim your original name if no one else takes it, or choose a new one if needed.

Your name will be freed if:
* Your character is level 54 or under and you have not played the game in 6+ months

----
That's all for this month's newsletter! We can't wait to see you in-game.

''By the way... does anyone else see something strange in the sky?''
